heroHeadline: Satellite Imagery Reveals Land Clearance at DPRK Facility Possibly Signaling Drone Base Expansion
heroSubtitle: 38North analysis of commercial satellite imagery shows land clearance activity at a North Korean facility consistent with drone base expansion, as inter-Korean tensions remain elevated following military threats exchanged over a DMZ blast on September 30, 2026. North Korea's growing drone program advances alongside its nuclear and ballistic missile capabilities.
footerNote: Data sourced from US/ROK official reports, KCNA, UN panels, IAEA, and institutional analyses. North Korea does not publish national statistics — economic figures are estimates with wide uncertainty ranges.
